item.title: Mamdani and Trump agree to delay on food stamp rules that put benefit at risk for millions
item.description:
New York City mayor says deal will allow bodegas and convenience stores across the country more time to comply

Zohran Mamdani, the New York City mayor, has struck a deal with Donald Trump to secure a 90-day delay on new rules for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (Snap), so that bodegas and corner stores across the country have time to comply.

The extension, Mamdani said, starts Friday as a result of conversations he had with Trump and Brooke Rollins, the agriculture secretary.

item.title: USA hammer Denmark 14-0 with record 85 shots to reach women’s hockey worlds semi-finals
item.description:
• Americans set tournament record with 85 shots on goal

  • Harvey and Winn score twice each in 14-0 rout

  • Canada edge Czechs 3-2 to set up Sweden semi-final

Defending champions the United States marched into the semi-finals of the women’s ice hockey world championship with a crushing 14-0 victory over hosts Denmark on Friday.

The Americans stormed out of the blocks, racing into a 5-0 lead inside eight minutes before stretching their advantage to 10-0 by the end of the second period in the first-ever meeting between the teams.

item.title: As Van Hollen wages a challenge, Senate Democrats are torn on whom to elect as their leader
item.description:
Maryland senator’s bid against Chuck Schumer for leadership could decide direction of the Democratic party

  • US politics live – latest updates

Ever since Donald Trump returned to the White House, Democratic officeholders and voters alike have been divided over whether their leader in the Senate, Chuck Schumer, is up to the task of taking the president on.

That debate intensified on Thursday, when the Maryland senator Chris Van Hollen announced he will challenge Schumer for the post of Democratic Senate leader, which will become one of the most powerful jobs in Washington when the party takes control of Congress’s upper chamber next year.
